task: Flagship 10 open-tennis-robots, buildable item: the servo's 5-6 V supply and the cable runs to the turntable, clear of the head out to the hard stops' 36.4 deg reach
errors: First elevation-loop model used a cubic Bezier with both end tangents vertical; with a clip under the pivot the control points are collinear, so the family can only make a straight line (and folded curves pass the curvature test). Found by exploring a quintic family; added a fold guard (tangent may not turn >90 deg between samples) to _cable_loop_range.
An exploratory scratch script split its own source on a marker string and broke (wasted one background run).
Existing test_elevation_sweep_can_fail asserted Feeder(mast_top_z=700).check() == []; the new cable rule correctly flags that design too, so the test now filters the cable rule out.
Post front matter: description 233 chars and seo_title 80 chars; caught by venture-preflight and fixed.
Two new geometry tests were first appended to ElevationStopTest, which has no setUpClass fixture; moved to a new CableGeometryTest class.

doc_friction.issue: Without build123d in python3 it reports the open-tennis-robots suite as failed with ModuleNotFoundError in a FeederParamsTest (test_take_up_parts_match_the_design imports build123d unguarded). With PATH pointing at a venv holding build123d it passed in 0.3 s, which suggests the CAD tests were not what ran; I ran cad/tests with pytest directly.

_hose_curve_range/_hose_curve_range_3d have the same blind spot I fixed in the new cable function: a fold back along a straight line has zero cross product, so it passes the curvature limit. Hose tangents are rarely collinear, so it is probably harmless, but nobody has checked.

notes: Landed: Feeder.cable_twist, cable_loop_design (checked over the actuator's whole travel, -30.3 to +45.8 deg), servo_supply, check_cables; CAD parts cable_clip, cable_gland, cable_clamp and cable_crossbar, plus a 14 mm grommet hole in the motor plate; package.cable_sweep (7 elevations x straight and +-36.4 deg, no clash); regenerated feeder package (design_rules [] and collisions []). Finding: a clip under the pivot cannot work (about 8.4 mm of slack possible at R 30 over the 106 mm span, about 13 needed); the loop behind the pivot gives a 353-398 mm window, cut at 376. Servo: 20 AWG leads, 5.68 V at stall; 26 AWG gives 4.88 V and lifts the ground 0.56 V. electronics.md's 6-7.4 V BEC changed to a 6 V buck. No agent doc: everything the next run needs is in cad/README.md and flagships.yaml next. Verification: cad/tests pytest (build123d 0.13.0 venv): 64 passed, then 2 failed because I had put two new geometry tests in ElevationStopTest, which has no parts fixture; moved them to their own CableGeometryTest class, and all 5 cable tests passed (168 s). node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs open-tennis-robots: clean, after fixing the post's front-matter lengths. Feeder package regenerated (4 min 14 s), manifest design_rules [] and collisions [].
